name: com.vitalitynode/exchange-rates
title: VitalityNode Exchange Rates
description: Official FX rates from central banks and tax offices, with source documents, plus street rates.

tools.name: official_rate
tools.description: Official exchange rate of a named publisher on a date, with a proof link: central banks (ECB, Fed H.10, Bank of Canada, central bank of the currency's own country), tax and customs rates (IRS yearly average, HMRC monthly and yearly, SUNAT, Korea customs), U.S. Treasury, UN. How many `quote` for 1 `base`. `source` picks the publisher (list_sources shows them; default ecb). `period` YYYY or YYYY-MM instead of `date` selects a yearly or monthly average. Several currencies: `quote` as EUR,GBP,JPY.

quote.description: ISO 4217 code, or up to 30 codes separated by commas

source.description: Publisher table code, e.g. ecb, irs-yearly, hmrc-monthly, cbr, sunat

period.description: YYYY or YYYY-MM (averages; instead of date)

tools.name: official_series
tools.description: The official rate of one publisher table for each day from `from` to `to` (at most 366 days; default: the last 30 days). Each day says how the rate was taken (published or the previous publication on a weekend). For a currency history, devaluation over a year, or a rate on many dates.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Catalog of official rate tables: central banks, tax offices (IRS, HMRC, SUNAT), customs, treasuries - country, currencies, history start, latest value, terms. Filter by `country` (ISO 3166 alpha-2) or `currency` to find which `source` to use for official_rate.

tools.name: country_rates
tools.description: Official and street rates for one country: the official rate the state declares, the street rate (black market, parallel market, dólar blue, dólar paralelo, tasa BCV vs monitor, aboki) as a median of P2P and exchange prices with USDT as 1 USD, the gap between them, the value lost against USD over `period` days (devaluation), the sources of each number, or n/a with the reason. Beta.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. AR, VE, NG, IR

period.description: Days for value lost (1-3650) or ytd; default 360

tools.name: world_rankings
tools.description: Official and street rates for every country at once. kind=gap: official vs street (black market, parallel) rate on a day, largest gaps first. kind=risk: value lost against USD over `period` (30, 90, 180, 360 days or ytd), biggest devaluation first. Returns the top countries in detail and every country in short.

tools.name: currency_days
tools.description: Daily series of official and street rates for one currency: official rate, street (black market) rate and gap for each day from `from` to `to`. Up to 60 days is free here; longer series are paid on the HTTP API.
